title: Potential Societal Biases of ChatGPT in Higher Education: A Scoping Review
findings: The paper, a scoping review, identifies religion as a category of societal bias in GAI. It cites an OpenAI Report (2019) which found a strong associative bias linking the word 'God' with Christianity, attributed to the prevalence of Christian texts in the training data. The review's own analysis of recent literature found that only two of the 31 selected papers on GAI bias in higher education mentioned religious bias.
